Load libraries
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/environment_set.R")
```

Load data
```{r}
entropy_clusters = read.csv("~/Downloads/Spatial_Gobbini/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv")
counts = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
traitData = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")

counts = counts[,rownames(traitData)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data

all.equal(rownames(traitData), colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order
```

Match with bulk
```{r}
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

traitData = traitData[rownames(traitData)%in%rownames(df_entropy),]
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(traitData)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[colnames(counts),]

all.equal(rownames(df_entropy), colnames(counts))
```

Deconvolution
```{r}
deconv = read.csv("../input/Deconvolution_Gobbini.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rownames(.)%in%colnames(counts))

deconv_subgroups = multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconvolution = deconv, 
                                                               corr = 0.7, 
                                                               seed = 123, 
                                                               file_name = "Gobbini", 
                                                               cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Plasma", "Tcells"),
                                                               return = TRUE) 
```

TF analysis
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/environment_set.R")
counts.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm)
network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.8, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 
```

Pathway analysis
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm)
```

Immunoscores
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/immunoscores.R")
immunescores = compute_gold_standards(counts.norm)
```

TME-niches
```{r}
cell_groups = construct_cell_groups(counts.norm, tfs, deconv, network, deconv_subgroups, traitData, pval = 0.05, 
                                    high_corr_groups = 0.9, clustering.method = "ward.D2", trait = "R.NR", positive = "R") 
```

CD8 Density per megacluster (High vs Low)
```{r}
megaclusters_levels = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Enriched_pDC_level = ifelse(.data$Enriched_pDC > summary(.data$Enriched_pDC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC_level = ifelse(.data$Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC > summary(.data$Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Enriched_cDC1_level = ifelse(.data$Enriched_cDC1 > summary(.data$Enriched_cDC1)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Mixed_cDC2_pDC_level = ifelse(.data$Mixed_cDC2_pDC > summary(.data$Mixed_cDC2_pDC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Enriched_cDC2_level = ifelse(.data$Enriched_cDC2 > summary(.data$Enriched_cDC2)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Enriched_Mature_DC_level = ifelse(.data$Enriched_Mature_DC > summary(.data$Enriched_Mature_DC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Mixed_cDC1_pDC_level = ifelse(.data$Mixed_cDC1_pDC > summary(.data$Mixed_cDC1_pDC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC_level = ifelse(.data$Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC > summary(.data$Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC)[3], "High", "Low"),
                cDC1positive_level = ifelse(.data$`cDC1+` > summary(.data$`cDC1+`)[3], "High", "Low"),)
```

Heatmaps
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Response = traitData$R.NR, 
  Enriched_pDC_level = megaclusters_levels$Enriched_pDC_level,
  Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC_level = megaclusters_levels$Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC_level,
  Enriched_cDC1_level = megaclusters_levels$Enriched_cDC1_level,
  Mixed_cDC2_pDC_level = megaclusters_levels$Mixed_cDC2_pDC_level,
  Enriched_cDC2_level = megaclusters_levels$Enriched_cDC2_level,
  Enriched_Mature_DC_level = megaclusters_levels$Enriched_Mature_DC_level,
  Mixed_cDC1_pDC_level = megaclusters_levels$Mixed_cDC1_pDC_level,
  Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC_level = megaclusters_levels$Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC_level,
  cDC1positive_level = megaclusters_levels$cDC1positive_level,
  
  col = list(
    Response = c("R" = "green", "NR" = "red"),
    Enriched_pDC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Mixed_cDC2_Mature_DC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Enriched_cDC1_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Mixed_cDC2_pDC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Enriched_cDC2_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Enriched_Mature_DC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Mixed_cDC1_pDC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    Mixed_pDC_Mature_DC_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white"),
    cDC1positive_level = c("High" = "black", "Low" = "white")
  ),
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)


## Clustered patients by CD8 enrichment 
dend_column = as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(log10(df_entropy+1e-5)), method = "ward.D2"))
```

Heatmap deconvolution
```{r}
ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(deconv_subgroups[[1]])), 
        border = T, cluster_columns = dend_column, 
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), 
        name = "Deconvolution", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"), 
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(35, "cm"), height = unit(90, "cm"), 
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


pdf("Results/Deconvolution", width = 30, height = 40)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht1, show_heatmap_legend = T, heatmap_legend_side = "left", annotation_legend_side = 'left')
dev.off()
```
